pages.text: DIG DUG CUSTOM CHIPS 99 Video Ram Addresser Allows RAM to be addressed by CPU and Sync chain. Requires CPU address bus to be tri-state during 2H high. 2 Universal Shift Register Can be set up for 4 4-bit parallel to serial converters or 2 8-bit parallel to serial converters. All registers use 1 set of control signals. Can shift either direction. £4 Motion Object Controller Generates the strobes and RAM addresses for the motion objects. (MOC 24 style) 96 Custom 50 Controller Interfaces between CPU and Custom 50's. (Custom 4 bit_microprocessors) Commands and data are transfered via the data bus. C/D selects com- mand or data. Part of the custom 50 data bus is address and part is data (apparently). 97 SYNC Generator Takes 6 MHZ and generates all horizontal and vertical_timing signals. More than 1 can be used in a system using HRESET and VRESET. 51 Coin I/0 Controller This custom microprocessor handles I/0 (R/W). 53 Steering Controller This custom microprocessor handles inputs (for Dig Dug). It also can apparently scan keyboards and handles steering controls. 8 different modes.
